name: Franz Xaver Waltenberger
headline: Managing Director @ CDTM Venture Fund | CDTM | TUM | HSE

ca.about:
Franz Waltenberger studied Technology and Management (B.Sc) at the Technical University of Munich and Politics, Economics and Philosophy (M.A.) at the Higher School of Economics in Moscow and Sciences Po in Paris.

During his studies Franz worked for several SMEs in the areas of finance, cryptocurrencies and political lobbying. In his spare time, he likes to build and restore electric and combustion-powered motorcycles and bikes and is collecting and analyzing data in comment sections of German news outlets to understand what shapes public opinion online.

Franz joined the CDTM in January 2021 and is responsible for the Trend Seminar and the Entrepreneurship Taskforce. In his research, he is focusing on the effects of information technology on human behavior.
researchFields: Effects of Persuasive Design on Online Discussion

summary: After four years as member of the management team of the Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM) Munich, I am now leveraging my industry insights to invest into early-stage ventures of current CDTM students and alumni.

positions.title: Co-Founder | Managing Director
positions.description: The CDTM Venture Fund ist the first university alumni VC fund in Germany, with a total volume of over €8.2mln raised exclusively from CDTM alumni. It deploys capital exclusively into high-potential startups with at least one CDTM co-founder. The fund donates 15% of its total profits (3/4 of its carried interest) back to the CDTM, strengthening the next generation of multinational CDTM-entrepreneurs.

positions.description: The Center for Digital Technology and Management offers Munich's most talented and motivated university students the opportunity to jointly learn and work together on exciting projects. The CDTM is a joint institution of the LMU München and TU München and entirely run by a team of doctoral candidates and its students.

company.name: CDTM Venture Fund
company.tagline: capital for the innovators of tomorrow
company.description:
CDTM is the birthplace of 25% of Germany’s unicorns. It’s not only one of the most selective educational institutions to get into, with a mere 6% acceptance rate, but it also boasts the highest "unicorn-to-alumni ratio" in the world (9 unicorns / 1,200 alumni). 

The CDTM Venture Fund is Germany’s first alumni fund. We invest in the next generation of CDTM startups at the (pre)seed stage and provide support to founders through our network of 300+ LPs, all of whom are entrepreneurial operators at heart. The majority of the carry is donated to CDTM.
